fixes.explanation: Right, baker. Hezekiah prays, “O Lord, I am oppressed; be my security.” (Isaiah 38:14) He's weak and worn out, and his eyes are growing weak as he looks upward. So he asks the Lord to stand behind him.
Yes, baker. The text says, “Prepare a lump of pressed figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover.” (Isaiah 38:21) That's Isaiah's exact instruction. Figs, friend. Just figs.
